The `sha256sums` array uses 'SKIP', which is normal and expected for VCS-based packages and does not imply any action during `--printsrcinfo`. There is no evidence of malicious code execution, data exfiltration, or unsafe operations occurring during the sourcing phase.

Therefore, running `makepkg --printsrcinfo` on this PKGBUILD is safe, as it will only parse metadata and not trigger any potentially harmful operations.
</details>
